observations: A subsequent ZTE methods study used largely 1H-free RF coils, including two birdcage coils and an 80-mm surface coil, at 3 T; detailed material composition and quantitative Q/SNR penalties were not available in the retrieved evidence.

source_tools.relevance: Supports reuse of the low-proton coil concept beyond the original 7-T implementation.
Supports the reported limitations in quantitative coil metrics.

entities.name: Virtually 1H-free ZTE birdcage
observations: A virtually 1H-free birdcage coil is experimentally feasible and can produce no detectable background above noise under standard ZTE acquisition.
The result is not mathematically zero proton signal: residual signal can emerge with extreme averaging from nearby proton-containing glass or interfaces.

source_tools.relevance: Independent supporting report of largely 1H-free birdcage use.

entities.name: Low-proton coil tradeoffs
observations: The available evidence does not quantify unloaded or loaded Q, transmit efficiency, receive sensitivity, SNR penalty, or power-handling effects for the demonstrated design.
Material-specific claims for PEEK, PTFE, ceramic, or composite birdcage designs remain unsupported by the retrieved evidence.

source_tools.relevance: Documents the evidence gap for engineering trade-offs.
Documents the absence of quantified material-specific performance.
